summary: Iteration 7 validates two new features: Tenant Ledger (backend + UI) and Tenant Autocomplete on Create Invoice. Backend pytest: 26/26 passed in 1.87s (includes test_tenant_ledger_running_balance + test_tenant_ledger_opening_balance_and_404). Live API smoke on preview URL: GET /api/tenants/9876501234/ledger returns 200 with exact expected summary {totalBilled:25250, totalPaid:16750, outstanding:8500, invoiceCount:3} and 5 rows sorted by date with alternating invoice/payment types and correct running balance (8400 -> 3400 -> 11750 -> 0 -> 8500). Charge column excludes previousBalance (invoice2 shows debit=8350 = 11750-3400). GET /api/tenants/0000000000/ledger => 404. Created throwaway tenant mobile 5551112222 with first invoice having previousBalance=500: ledger correctly prepends an 'opening' row (debit=500, description 'Opening balance (carried forward)') before the invoice row. After DELETE /api/tenants/5551112222, ledger still returns with tenant.deleted=true, name/mobile retained, and 2 rows intact (invoices preserved). Frontend E2E on preview URL: /tenants shows tenant-name-link-9876501234 and tenant-ledger-9876501234 (BookOpen button) — clicking navigates to /tenants/9876501234/ledger. Ledger page renders ledger-tenant-name='Rahul Sharma', ledger-total-billed=₹25,250.00, ledger-total-paid=₹16,750.00, ledger-outstanding=₹8,500.00, ledger-table with 5 rows, ledger-footer totals, ledger-back-link, ledger-new-invoice-btn. Clicking New Invoice navigates to /invoices/new?tenant=9876501234 and prefills tenant-name=Rahul Sharma, tenant-mobile=9876501234, tenant-email=rahul@example.com, room-number=101, bed-number=A. /tenants/0000000000/ledger renders ledger-error 'Tenant not found' with Back to tenants link. Create Invoice tenant autocomplete: focusing tenant-name opens tenant-suggestions dropdown showing 2 existing tenants; typing 'rah' filters to Rahul Sharma only; typing '9822' filters to Priya Patel only (mobile-digit filter works); typing 'rah' + ArrowDown + Enter fills all fields (name, mobile, email, room, bed) from Rahul; Escape hides list; clicking outside hides list; typing 'BrandNewNameXYZ' shows no dropdown (0 matches). Edit Invoice (/invoices/{id}/edit) does NOT show the suggestions dropdown when focusing tenant-name (plain input mode) — verified count=0. No page errors. All requested tests pass end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: tenant_ledger correctly derives charge as (invoiceTotal - previousBalance) so totalBilled never double-counts carried balances — verified numerically on 3-invoice seed.
Opening row is only inserted when the tenant's FIRST invoice has previousBalance>0, matching the chosen product spec.
Deleted tenants gracefully return tenant.deleted=true rather than 404 as long as invoices exist — good UX for historical review.
TenantNameInput: filter matches on lowercased name substring OR raw mobile substring — efficient and covers both search modes; capped at 8 results which is a sensible limit.
Autocomplete is scoped to CREATE mode only in CreateInvoice.jsx (editing uses plain Input) — prevents accidental identity swap on existing invoices.
onMouseDown uses e.preventDefault() to avoid input blur race — correct pattern for click-to-select in a listbox.
seed_data_creation: Created + soft-deleted throwaway tenant mobile=5551112222 (TEST_OpeningTenant) with 1 invoice SHPG-2026-0005 previousBalance=500 to validate opening-row and deleted-tenant ledger paths. Seed tenants Rahul Sharma (9876501234) and Priya Patel (9822011223) untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tenant Ledger and Tenant autocomplete are fully working. Preview SQLite now has an extra invoice SHPG-2026-0005 attached to soft-deleted tenant 5551112222 — this may affect downstream tenant/invoice counts but is expected. Regression checks (dashboard/history/payments/tenants load, invoice creation) were previously validated in iteration_6 and remain intact under this iteration.
